front: Which section of the Constitution lists the courts of Zimbabwe?
Name the courts listed in section 162.
back: Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, High Court, Labour Court, Administrative Court, magistrates courts, customary law courts.

front: Name six sources of law in Zimbabwe.
back: The Constitution, Acts of Parliament, statutory instruments, by-laws, customary law and common law.

front: Why can a court refuse to apply a custom?
back: Customary law applies only where it is consistent with the Constitution, which is supreme and protects equality and rights.

front: Constitutional Court or Supreme Court: what is the difference?
back: The Constitutional Court is the highest court on constitutional matters; the Supreme Court is the final court of appeal in other matters.
